ops.oldText: No title to the intellectual property in the Work is transferred to Sparkling by this Agreement.
ops.newText: Except as provided below, no title to the intellectual property in the Work is transferred to Sparkling by this Agreement.

ops.text: Sparkling owns all deliverables and work product created for Sparkling under this Agreement, including the Modifications, and Garman hereby assigns those deliverables and work product to Sparkling. Garman grants Sparkling a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free licence to any Garman intellectual property embedded in the deliverables. Sparkling retains all rights in Sparkling's data. No intellectual property created under this Agreement shall be jointly owned.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 13 currently vests the bespoke Schedule D Modifications in Garman with no licence back and says nothing about our data, so we have removed Modifications from Garman's blanket ownership and added one short clause assigning the deliverables and work product created for us, licensing any Garman intellectual property embedded in the deliverables on a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free basis, confirming our data remains ours and excluding joint ownership. Garman's ownership of the Work and its Improvements is unaffected.
proposal.summary: Carve the Modifications out of Garman's IP ownership and add a concise clause on Sparkling ownership of deliverables and work product, assignment, embedded-IP licence, data retention and no joint ownership.
